text: Hold!
zh: 站住！

text: You're at the frontline, so you better watch your step.
zh: 这里是前线，你最好小心行事。

text: Who are you?
zh: 你是谁？

text: What is south of here?
zh: 这里的南边是什么地方？

text: What are you fighting for?
zh: 你们在为什么而战？

text: Regarding the healing potions...
zh: 关于生命药水的事……

text: Can you help me get to the capital?
zh: 你能帮我进入王都吗？

text: I saw a huge shadow recently.
zh: 我最近看到了一个巨大的影子。

text: What do you know about the bandits nearby the capital?
zh: 关于王都附近的强盗，你知道些什么？

text: You are mentioned in these notes. (Sirynir's Notes)
zh: 这些笔记里提到了你。（西里尼尔的笔记）

text: See you!
zh: 回见！

text: Name's #:Renbrand:# - a commander serving under the king's orders.
zh: 我叫#:伦布兰德:#——奉国王之命行事的指挥官。

text: However, orcs and other creatures invaded the route and took up positions there.
zh: 然而，兽人和其他怪物侵占了那条路线，还在那里布下了阵地。

text:
So far, we've been able to prevent their attempts to occupy the north.
Albeit with some losses.
zh:
到目前为止，我们还能挡住它们北进的企图。
尽管付出了一些伤亡。

text: To be honest, I don't know how long we will be able to fight off the hordes.
zh: 说实话，我不知道我们还能抵挡这些大军多久。

text:
But as long as my bones are moving, I have to fight!
It is my duty!
zh:
但只要我这把骨头还能动，我就必须战斗！
这是我的职责！

text:
I am a Commander of the Royal Army.
It is my duty to fight for the king!
zh:
我是皇家军队的指挥官。
为国王而战是我的职责！

text: My family lives in the capital, so I have to stay strong to protect them.
zh: 我的家人住在王都，为了保护他们，我必须坚守下去。

text:
Thank you!
This will save more lives than you know!
zh:
谢谢你！
这能救下的性命比你想象的还多！

text: Fight until the end!
zh: 战斗到底！

text: You?
zh: 你？

text:
I think, you are a good man.
You don't seem like someone who would cause trouble in the capital.
zh:
我觉得你是个好人。
你看起来不像会在王都惹事的人。

text:
Here, take this.
The guards should let you pass.
zh:
来，拿着这个。
卫兵们应该会放你进去。

text: I am sorry, but I cannot risk such a thing. You are still a mere stranger.
zh: 抱歉，我不能冒这个险。你毕竟还只是个陌生人。

text: So you saw the dragon yourself?
zh: 这么说你亲眼见到那条龙了？

text: We think that he hides south of here, near the volcano.
zh: 我们认为它藏在这里的南边，火山附近。

text: We are already busy fighting here at the frontline, so we can't divide our forces to handle the dragon as well.
zh: 我们在前线的战斗已经自顾不暇，实在抽不出兵力再去对付那条龙。

text: We're running out of #text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#healing potions#text.default# at a rapid rate.
zh: 我们的#text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#生命药水#text.default#正在急速耗尽。

text: Yes?
zh: 什么事？

text: Here are 10 Health Potions (Weak).
zh: 这是10瓶生命药水（弱效）。

text: Here are 5 Health Potions (Small).
zh: 这是5瓶生命药水（小型）。

text: Here are 2 Health Potions (Medium).
zh: 这是2瓶生命药水（中型）。

text: Nevermind...
zh: 没什么……

text: Don't waste my time!
zh: 别浪费我的时间！

text: There used to be a trade route to #:Erstadt:#.
zh: 这里以前有一条通往#:埃尔施塔特:#的商路。

text:
About the bandits?
Nothing in particular, if I am being honest.
zh:
强盗的事？
老实说，没什么特别的。

text: Also, bandits are not my biggest problem, as they don't occupy the trade route to Erstadt right now.
zh: 再说，强盗也不是我最头疼的问题，毕竟眼下占据通往埃尔施塔特商路的不是他们。

text: However, I can't think of a reason why the bandits are more important to the king, than the trade route.
zh: 不过，我实在想不通，在国王眼里，强盗怎么会比商路还重要。

text: Have you ever had to deal with the bandits?
zh: 你和那些强盗打过交道吗？

text: It was a few months ago, before I was sent here to guard the border to the south.
zh: 那是几个月前的事了，当时我还没被派来驻守南方边境。

text: The usual group had to take a break, so at that time it was my duty to protect the area from bandits.
zh: 平时负责的那队人需要休整，所以那阵子防备强盗的差事就落到了我头上。

text: Did the order come directly from the king?
zh: 命令是国王直接下达的吗？

text: Yes, of course!
zh: 是的，当然！

text: Although I found it strange that this task was given to a high-ranking member of the Royal Guard.
zh: 不过我也觉得奇怪，这种任务竟然交给了皇家卫队的高级成员。

text: We also had to confiscate all valuables, including notes and scrolls, and hand them over to the quartermaster.
zh: 我们还得没收所有值钱的东西，包括笔记和卷轴，并统一上交给军需官。

text:
But enough of that.
I need to get back to my task.
zh:
不过就聊到这儿吧。
我得回去继续执行任务了。

text:
What do you mean?
Let me see.
zh:
你这是什么意思？
让我看看。

text:
That is... Sirynir!
Where did you find these notes?
zh:
这是……西里尼尔！
你在哪儿找到这些笔记的？

text: You knew Sirynir?
zh: 你认识西里尼尔？

text: I found the notes in the ruins.
zh: 我在遗迹里找到了这些笔记。

text: Commander Sirynir was my superior a few years ago.
zh: 西里尼尔指挥官几年前是我的上级。

text:
He taught me everything I needed to know as a Royal Guard.
Without him, I wouldn't be here today.
zh:
身为皇家卫队的一员该懂的一切，都是他教给我的。
没有他，就没有今天的我。

text: Unfortunately, Sirynir disappeared along with other guards during an expedition to the ruins near the capital.
zh: 不幸的是，在一次前往王都附近遗迹的远征中，西里尼尔和其他几名卫兵一起失踪了。

text:
So it's true. He died there.
I feared as much.
zh:
这么说是真的。他死在了那里。
我早就担心会是这样。

text: Please leave me his notes... his last words.
zh: 请把他的笔记留给我……那是他最后的遗言。

text: Take this instead.
zh: 拿这个作交换吧。

text: I found this #:thing:# during the expedition to the ruins. When I went to check on Sirynir for a moment, I found it near a destroyed bell.
zh: 这个#:东西:#是我在那次遗迹远征中找到的。当时我去查看西里尼尔的情况，在一口毁坏的钟旁边发现了它。

text: I kept it as a memento of my former commander. However, I no longer have any use for it.
zh: 我一直把它留作纪念我的老指挥官。不过，如今它对我已经没什么用处了。

text: Thank you!
zh: 谢谢你！
